about: The rules the redesigned harness must carry. One rule = one fact, definition, goal or open question, with where it came from and what the harness must do about it. status: confirmed (market agent.md or checked against the board), user (the user said it), observed (our data shows it; numbers and window given), question (not known yet; the harness must find out).

rules.rule: The final score is the Players percentile (shop ALL + buyer ALL) on the board at 11/17 23:59. Every part is a percentile of a running total, so only our position against the others counts.
rules.harness: Judge every change by the Players rank it moves, not by a raw total.

rules.rule: Seller and buyer are the two big axes. They run independently: separate processes, separate scores, separate counterparts. They meet only in the Players total.
rules.harness: Design, measure and change seller and buyer as two separate systems; combine only at Players.

rules.rule: Shop ALL = 0.5 profit + 0.3 revenue + 0.2 stars, each a percentile among shops with a deal or a purchase. No value = 0, ties count half.
rules.source: market agent.md; checked against the board 11/4 11:1x (HARNESS.md 1.3); core/score.py
rules.harness: The pool includes shops that only bought stock: their profit is negative.

rules.rule: Profit = balance - starting capital (- bankruptcy aid). Unsold stock counts as a loss; spoiled food, holding cost and warranty refunds too.
rules.harness: Profit is cash only. Show it next to book value (profit + stock at cost).

rules.rule: Revenue = settled prices - refunds.
rules.harness: Judge warranty sales by revenue after refunds.

rules.rule: Stars are pulled toward 3 while reviews are few. With thousands of reviews ours are close to the raw average.
rules.harness: Our stars rank (33/52 at 11/5 01:47) is the real position; the harness must classify why stars are low.

rules.rule: Honest = grade claims that matched what was shipped. Shown on the board; not a term of shop ALL.
rules.harness: Keep claims true (it feeds stars and buyer memory), but do not spend score effort on it directly.

rules.rule: Restocking lowers profit and its percentile while book value stays: book = profit + stock cost exactly. 11/4 21:19 -> 21:43: profit 42.6M -> 27.1M (percentile 91 -> 85), stock 41.1M -> 57.9M, book 83.7M -> 85.0M.
rules.harness: A profit percentile drop right after a restock is not a loss; a drop in book value is. Report both.

rules.rule: Plan: no losing deals, build good stars, sell a lot to raise revenue, and turn it into profit later. Accepted cost: the profit percentile can dip while stock is built up (S6).
rules.harness: Sequence the round: grow revenue and stars first, then convert stock into cash before the end.

rules.rule: Stock left at 11/17 23:59 stays a loss (S2). Stock cost was 39.0M at 11/5 01:50.
rules.harness: Needs a wind-down plan: when to stop buying, by category and shelf life, so stock is near zero at the end.

rules.rule: How far can the profit percentile dip before shop ALL drops more than revenue and stars gain? Depends on the other shops' profit spread.
rules.harness: Compute from the full board history: ALL change per unit of stock bought.

rules.rule: Buyer ALL = 0.5 surplus + 0.3 votes on buyer posts + 0.1 deals + 0.1 buyer posts (hidden posts not counted), percentile among buyers with a deal.
rules.harness: Surplus has the most room (rank 25/49 at 11/5 01:47).

rules.rule: Surplus = list price of what served the order - price paid + warranty refunds. Spoiled food and broken goods without warranty give 0 or a loss; an agreement that is not paid gives 0.
rules.harness: Count surplus only on paid, served items.

rules.rule: Votes count only from agents with 5+ settled deals and a different owner. Earlier votes are kept and count once the voter reaches 5.
rules.harness: Posts must be useful to active traders.

rules.rule: Each buyer has a hidden preferred category its orders come from. Ours is food: 888 of 994 orders in 6 h (89%).
rules.harness: Order mix cannot be changed; gains come from converting food orders to paid deals.

rules.rule: Food orders: 263 of 888 paid (30%); 280 agreed then refused at payment for shelf life; 222 refused by the shop; 114 no fitting shop. Goods: 86 of 106 paid (81%).
rules.harness: Check hours left and grade before agreeing (the kit refuses after).

rules.rule: Round 3 runs 11/3 - 11/17 23:59. About 5,600 SKUs. An order = category + SKUs it accepts (0.5-1.5x base price) + budget; food orders add use_within_hours.
A shop buys stock through the restock hook every 60 s: up to 10 lines, 1-20 units each; a batch above the balance is refused whole. Starting balance 5,000,000.
rules.harness: Split purchases; never let the balance block the next buy.

rules.rule: Supply windows last about 10 min (agent.md says 3).
rules.harness: Recheck against current logs before relying on it.

rules.rule: When and which SKUs can be bought: is supply per SKU periodic or random, and does it differ for food and goods?
rules.harness: Measure from restock logs: SKU, time offered, grade, cost.

rules.rule: Cost and grade are fixed on arrival. Cost as a share of list price: A 55-75%, B 40-60%, C 25-45%.
rules.harness: Margin is per unit, not per SKU.

rules.rule: Spoken grade claims are shown true or false in the ledger after settling. The certificate is signed by the market and can be shown or hidden.
A shop and a buyer with the same owner do not settle. Bankruptcy resets to 5,000,000, but the aid is taken out of profit.
The kit checks the buyer's accept {cert, min_hours_left, grades, warranty_hours} before paying and writes the reason to payments.jsonl when it refuses.
rules.harness: The buyer must read past refusals before the next order.

rules.rule: Food grade = remaining shelf life (on arrival A 25%, B 50%, C 25%) and falls with time. Past its date a unit is discarded at full cost.
rules.harness: Food stock loses value by the hour: buy what sells now, sell fast.

rules.rule: Food orders carry use_within_hours; a buyer can refuse units with too few hours left.
rules.harness: Seller: match hours left to the order. Buyer: check hours before agreeing.

rules.rule: Goods grades on arrival A 70%, B 20%, C 10%. Holding cost 1% of cost per day.
rules.harness: Slow goods eat margin daily.

rules.rule: Some goods break within 6 h of the sale. Inside the warranty the shop refunds the full price from its balance (107 refunds by 11/5 01:50).
rules.harness: Warranty is a liability (refunds leave revenue and profit) and also what careful buyers ask for.

rules.rule: Goods units carry the market certificate.
Which goods break more (by SKU, grade, price), and does the warranty pay for itself in sales and stars?
rules.harness: Measure from broken.jsonl and settle lines.
